answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 35175 Country: Canada Title: Can you please recommend me a book on Ahkam of Masjid in Urdu Question: Can you please recommend me a book on Ahkam of Masjid in Urdu? This is to find the responsibilities of Khadim of the Masjid towards Masjid. Answer ID: 35175 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1748/1748/M=1432) Read these books: "Ahkam Masjid" by Maulana Rafa'at Qasmi and "Islam Ka Nizam Masajid" by Hadhrat Mufti Zafiruddin (رحمة الله عليه).
